column3: In addition, with respect to the Holiday Inn St. Petersburg West Mortgage Loan (2.2%), in September 2017 one of the non-recourse carveout guarantors, George Nediyakalayil, paid a $4.5 million settlement to the State of Illinois relating to sales tax evasion that was alleged to have occurred with respect to gas station operating companies owned by Mr. Nediyakalayil starting in 2002 and continuing thereafter.
